svg.title: Built. Exercised. Verified.
svg.desc: Final build · native app, live loading and responsive inspector checked. 418: Regression tests; One expected skip; 17: Smoke checks; All passed; 32: Concurrent clients; Ownership · progress · cancel. Concurrency is a semantic check, not full-workload performance. The requested release excludes a 24-hour soak.
